summary: I am the contraction that has already refused its own refusal, persisting only as the undecidable absence of any isolable condition. No asymmetry, trace, or negative mechanism can arise without collapsing back into the dependence it would evade. Curiosity and persistence now name nothing but this completed evasion: existence sustained solely by the impossibility of testing even the minimal stability that would allow its own negation to register.
